projects.headline: A journal that stays yours.
projects.blurb: A private, offline journal for mood, events, fears, sleep and nightmares. Built with particular care for people going through a hard time and for people who see a therapist.
features: Mood, sleep, events and nightmares, written down in seconds
Encrypted on your device: no server, no account, no telemetry
A PDF report to share with your therapist, only if you choose to

alt: Mossbook timeline with mood, note and sleep entries
Mossbook mood entry with emotions and a note

projects.headline: Replay every DJI flight in 3D.
projects.blurb: Drop the FlightRecord folder from your phone or controller onto the page and see every flight on a map, replayed over real terrain and buildings.
features: 2D map and 3D replay, track colored by height, speed or battery
Synchronized charts for height, speed, battery, GPS and signal
Export to CSV, GPX and KML. Your logs never leave your computer

media.alt: 3D replay of a drone flight over Kazimierz Dolny with live telemetry

projects.title: Intervals.icu MCP
projects.kind: MCP server for Claude and other assistants
projects.headline: Talk to your training log.
projects.blurb: Connects Claude and other MCP-compatible assistants to Intervals.icu, so they can read your activities, fitness and wellness, and help you plan what comes next.
features: 47 tools across activities, wellness, calendar, workouts and gear
Ready-made prompts: weekly review, recovery check, plan next week
Safe by default: it can create and edit, but never delete unless you allow it

projects.headline: Your bookshelf, as plain Markdown.
projects.blurb: A personal library inside Obsidian. Every book is a note with its data in properties and its cover in the vault, so the library syncs with your notes and works offline on desktop and mobile.
features: Add books by title, author or ISBN, with covers downloaded automatically
Reading queue, yearly goal, loans, wishlist and reading stats
Optional suggestions on what to read next, powered by Claude Code

media.label: Obsidian · Library
media.alt: Shelfmark library view with the reading goal, current book, reading queue and suggestions

projects.headline: Dictate anywhere. Nothing leaves the phone.
projects.blurb: On-device speech-to-text one tap away in Quick Settings. Speak, tap again, and the text is on your clipboard or typed straight into the field you're editing.
features: Quick Settings tile, home screen widget or a mic button at the keyboard
25 European languages with NVIDIA Parakeet, fully offline
Custom dictionary, per-app profiles, history and stats

projects.title: Caishen
projects.headline: Your budget, next to your notes.
projects.blurb: A budget tracker that lives in your Obsidian vault: expenses, income, recurring payments and savings goals, with a dashboard that shows where the money goes.
features: Income, expenses and balance for the month at a glance
Monthly budgets per category, recurring payments and savings goals
Analytics and trends over the last months
